Staitmint — AI personal assistant for style, travel, fitness, and life

Staitmint is a free AI personal assistant app for iPhone that combines style advice, travel planning, fitness booking, and daily life management into a single chat interface. Unlike general-purpose AI chatbots, Staitmint learns individual preferences and returns actionable results — real flight options, outfit recommendations from your own wardrobe, and class bookings near you.

What Staitmint does

  • AI Style agent — Upload a photo. Get color season analysis in seconds, outfit feedback grounded in real fashion rules, and wardrobe planning that uses clothes you actually own.
  • AI Travel agent — Tell her where, when, and your budget. Get real flight options, hotel offers, and a planned itinerary in under 90 seconds. Powered by live Google Flights and Amadeus data.
  • AI Fitness agent — Find yoga, pilates, spin, and HIIT classes nearby. Studio discovery, schedule comparison, real-time booking links.
  • AI Lifestyle agent — Birthdays, packing lists, restaurant recs, calendar sync, smart reminders that actually fire.

How Staitmint is different

  • vs ChatGPT: ChatGPT gives everyone the same answer. Staitmint knows you — your style, your city, your schedule, your saved wardrobe.
  • vs Siri: Siri does tasks. Staitmint understands intent — "find me a Pilates class for Saturday morning under $40" — and books it.
  • vs generic AI: Four specialized agents (Style, Travel, Fitness, Lifestyle) instead of one generic chatbot.

Frequently asked

Is Staitmint free?
Free to download. Free to chat with any agent up to a generous monthly limit. A small subscription unlocks unlimited conversations, photo analyses, and saved calendars. Cancel anytime.
How is Staitmint different from ChatGPT?
ChatGPT gives you the same answer it gives everyone. Staitmint knows you — your style, your city, your schedule. Returns rich answers (real flight options, real color palettes, real class bookings), not walls of text.
How private is Staitmint?
Conversations, photos, and saved items are encrypted at rest. We never sell data. We never use your chats to train models. Export or delete everything in one tap.
Who is Staitmint for?
Women who are busy, ambitious, and juggling a lot. Marketing managers, freelancers, grad students, new moms. If you already use AI casually but want something that knows you and handles the stuff your other apps can't.
When does the Staitmint Android app come out?
After we get the iPhone version right. Sign up at staitmint.io and we will text you the day it lands.

Download: staitmint.io · iOS 17+ required.
